title: 2025-05-14 Chapter 2 — Stage 1 Rulings
lede: Four Stage 1 decisions need a ruling. The cleaned VTT is primary evidence; chapter_02 is only corroboration because it spans this session and the next two.
footer: Applied without asking: five mechanical edits in session-summary.md — the Gnomengarde reward attribution, two previously approved Goodberry certainty fixes, the previously approved passage qualifier, and one missing space. Three advisory findings required no change because the text was already explicit or the GM had settled the wording at Stage 0.

items.t: Clarify that Dwarven Excavation offered a guaranteed 50 gp while Gnomengarde's 50 gp was conditional.
items.y: Edit the summary prose and quest-board scene in session-summary.md so the choice is not presented as Dwarven Excavation simply paying more.
items.n: Leave session-summary.md unchanged and retain the chapter's framing that the Dwarven quest had the highest payout.
items.ev: session-summary.md:18 and :170 say the fifty gold or pay decided the choice. The cleaned VTT at ...speakers.cleaned.vtt:4877-4953 gives Dwarven Excavation 50 gp and then gives Gnomengarde a conditional 50 gp. The post-hoc chapter at docs/chapters/chapter_02_arrival_in_phandalin.md:171 says Dwarven Excavation had the highest payout, but that chapter spans three sessions.

items.t: Remove the reversed drum-lesson attribution from the character-introduction scene.
items.y: Replace the sentence in session-summary.md:131 with neutral wording that the group discussed drum lessons, without claiming Soma offered to teach Vukradin.
items.n: Keep the current claim that Soma offered to teach Vukradin drums despite the merged cue beginning with 'Teach me the drums.'
items.ev: The cleaned VTT's merged, uncertain speaker cue at ...speakers.cleaned.vtt:1989 begins 'Teach me the drums,' then combines several voices; session-summary.md:131 turns that into Soma offering to teach Vukradin. Neutral wording preserves the exchange without inventing a direction for the lesson.

items.t: Name the Triboar Trail leg when describing the party's arrival in Phandalin.
items.y: Clarify the arrival headings in gm-assist.md:92 and session-summary.md:146: the party traveled south on the High Road, then approached Phandalin on the Triboar Trail.
items.n: Leave both headings as High Road-only shorthand; the nearby enhanced-summary bullet will still say the party entered from the Triboar direction.
items.ev: The GM calls the earlier travel the High Road at ...speakers.cleaned.vtt:3589 and says the party enters from Triboar at :3733. The campaign chapter explicitly names both roads at docs/chapters/chapter_02_arrival_in_phandalin.md:83; the registry places the High Road west of Phandalin and identifies the Triboar Trail as the east-west route.

items.t: Remove the unsupported claim that the prospectors met the ochre jelly deeper inside the temple.
items.y: Change the Norbus entries in gm-assist.md:156 and session-summary.md:227 to say the prospectors saw an ochre jelly somewhere inside and fled.
items.n: Keep 'encountered deeper inside' in both files as defensible compression, even though this session does not establish a chamber or depth.
items.ev: The cleaned VTT says only 'We did see an ochre jelly' and 'We ran out before we could face them' at ...speakers.cleaned.vtt:7265-7273. The main summary already uses 'inside' at session-summary.md:20 and 'somewhere inside' at :24.
